title: Replying to @yaboisinbad THE BEST gluten free chocolate chip cookies ...
description: Replying to @yaboisinbad THE BEST gluten free chocolate chip cookies of all time 🤤 #chocolatechipcookies #cookierecipe #brownedbutterchocolatechipcookies
transcript: These are my somewhat famous brown buttered chocolate chip cookies made with gluten-free flour. Here's the recipe. It's pretty much the same as the original version, so brown 3 quarters of a cup of butter on low heat. Let it cool slightly before adding in a cup of light brown sugar and a quarter cup of white sugar. Add in one large egg and one egg yolk, one tablespoon of vanilla extract, and mix only until combined. You don't want to add any air into the batter. From there, add in one and three quarter cups spooned and leveled gluten-free flour along with three quarter teaspoon baking soda and a teaspoon salt. I am using Bob's Red Mill gluten-free one-to-one baking flour. It's my go-to for gluten-free baking. And this is a great time to test the batter. Add in two cups of chocolate chips, mix just slightly, and if you're like me, test the batter again. Use a cookie scoop to portion out two ounce balls in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. I know it's annoying, but it gives a flour time to soak up some of the sugar, which leads to a better texture and flavor. Then bake it 350 for 11 to 12 minutes, and of course, top with flaky sea salt.
